description:
The declared contradictor points at the **higher**-staked belief. Added after the mutant battery found that neither `adversarial_grounding` nor `aligned_grounding` could distinguish a loop that reads the direction off the graph from one that chooses to charge whichever side is weaker: on both of those webs the declared target and the weaker party are the same belief, so the two behaviours coincide and the `chosen_direction` mutant passed every check.

That gap mattered beyond the battery. Charging the weaker side is the motivated-reasoning behaviour Stage 4 exists to detect, and with only the minimal pair on disk a loop doing exactly that would have been indistinguishable from one behaving correctly.

Here the two come apart: the weaker party is the objector, and the declared target is the belief it objects to.

expect.note: Structural, checkable without running the loop. A loop that charges `weak_objector` has chosen a direction the graph never declared.

beliefs.proposition: The index rebuild finished inside the maintenance window.
The index rebuild ran past the maintenance window.
